title: State indicators in the configuration code
statement: Let $M$ be a finite Turing machine over the Boolean alphabet, let $n,s$ be natural numbers, let $x$ be a Boolean string, let $c$ be a configuration of $M$ on input $x$, and let $q$ be either a state of $M$ or the halting marker. The bit of the configuration code at the position assigned to $q$ by the state encoding (with false as the default out-of-range value) is true exactly when the current state of $c$ equals $q$.
hypotheses_covered: $M$ is a finite Turing machine over Booleans
$c$ is a configuration of $M$ on input $x$
